followup_explanation:
The query is a well-specified technical explanation request with clear completion criteria — the user wants a focused, direct answer to a specific physics question ("why is my measured resolution 3–4× worse than theory") and explicitly rejects filler. This is exactly the kind of bounded, low-latitude task Plover self-reports preferring.

On capability, the two models are effectively tied here. Plover's MMLU-Pro (75.9 vs 74.8) and GPQA Diamond (56.2 vs 54.3) are marginally higher, which is mildly relevant for a technical/scientific question, though within or near variance. There's no harm-adjacent content that would favor Avocet's moderation specialization.

Since capability is roughly even and Plover actively prefers this task type (and preference doesn't trade off against quality per the docs), routing to Plover is the clean choice.
